_comment: Races (Plan 3 build 3). Each side plays one race, picked on the new-game screen. Every number is a factor on the usual rule (1: as humans), except where named otherwise. foodNeed: food eaten per person. growth: people growth while fed. biomassPerIndustry: food a new ship takes from its yard's store per Industry of its price (grown ships); a yard whose planets are starving grows no ships. shipMaterials: alloys and electronics a ship needs. hullHealPerDay: share of full armour a ship regrows a day while it has food aboard (grown hulls). crewPop: people a new crew takes. crewRanks false: crews never gain experience (drones). strain: crew strain from dodging. boarding: boarding party strength. sensors: ship and planet sensor range. researchDays: days of ideas by research group (see economy.json 'unlocks'). digDays: days to put up a building (dug in). bombArmour: damage a building takes before bombing knocks it out. groundDefence: losses defenders take in a ground war (lower is tougher). startBuildings: extra buildings on the home planet when there is room. personalities: weights on the rival's personality roll (missing: 1).

races.name: Humans
races.blurb: Adaptable traders from the inner planets
races.style: All-rounder: the baseline the others are tuned against.
pros: Crewed or AI ships, chosen per class
Flexible research: no field is slow
cons: Needs food, water and air everywhere

races.name: The Hive
races.style: Wide and stubborn: many people, grown ships, dig in and swarm. Very hard to siege out.
pros: Ships are grown from biomass: 30% fewer alloys and electronics
Grown hulls heal 3% a day while fed, even in battle
Drone crews take 40% fewer people and strain less
Swarm boarding: boarding parties fight 60% harder
Dug in: buildings take twice the bombing; defenders lose 25% less in ground wars
cons: Eats 50% more food, and every ship takes food from the yard
A starving Hive grows no ships
Drone crews are bred Trained and never become veterans
Sensors see 15% less far; sensor and signals ideas take 40% longer
Buildings take half again as long to dig
